name: Introduction to Digitization
description: This course will introduce students to the digitisation and subsequent archiving of cultural material like texts, oral testimony, and other ephemera. It will focus on ethics of sourcing and handling objects, digitization equipment, formats and compression methods, and digitization life cycle and repositories.
